nodes.name: Way in
nodes.text: Where the ship came into the sector.

nodes.name: Jump point
nodes.text: The way on to the next sector. Jump from here and this one is behind you.

nodes.name: Station
nodes.text: A tired station selling supplies by the crate. Cash only, and the coffee is extra.

nodes.name: Nebula
nodes.text: A cloud of charged dust where sensors see nothing, theirs included. A good place to sit tight.

nodes.name: World
nodes.text: A world past the charts, where a colony could take root.

nodes.name: Empty space
nodes.text: Rock, dust and nobody. Nothing to stop for.

nodes.name: Derelict
nodes.text: Something dead and drifting, with whatever it carried still aboard.

nodes.name: Distress call
nodes.text: Someone on the emergency band, asking for help. Or saying they are.

nodes.name: Trader
nodes.text: A ship that sells, buys and asks no questions.

nodes.name: Hazard
nodes.text: Weather, rock or worse. Getting through costs something.

nodes.name: Hostile ship
nodes.text: A ship running dark, guns warm. It has seen you, and it isn't here to trade.
